app.tagline: Music from Spotify, SoundCloud and YouTube into your library
login.title: Sign in
setup.title: Welcome to Nightshift
setup.intro: Two minutes and you're set: create the admin account and connect your library.
setup.admin.hint: This account manages settings and users.
setup.library.hint: Inside Docker this is /music – mapped to your music folder.
setup.cookie.hint: Netscape format, for age-restricted videos. Can be changed later in settings.
download.title: Download
nightly.title: Nightly sync
nightly.desc: Keeps all sync playlists up to date automatically.
console.title: Console
sync.title: Sync playlists

settings.title: Settings
search.title: Search
search.hint: Searches the iTunes catalog – downloads run through Spotify/spotDL.
settings.field.sync_enabled: Offer sync playlist option in the interface
settings.field.nd_default_public: Make new playlists public by default
settings.users.name: Username
settings.reset.confirm: Really reset ALL settings to their defaults? Users are kept.
settings.hint.music_root.docker: When running in Docker, keep this at /music. To use a different folder, change the volume mapping in docker-compose.yml (e.g. /your/path:/music).
settings.hint.path.docker: Must be a path inside the container – ideally below /config.
sync.remove.confirm: Really remove '{name}' from sync? Already downloaded music is kept.
settings.hint.keep_removed_tracks: When off, songs that disappear from the Spotify playlist are also deleted from your library during the nightly sync.

settings.field.soundcloud_cookie_upload: Update SoundCloud cookies: drop a file here or click
settings.cookies.wrongsite: Careful, these cookies are not for
cookies.expired.title: Cookies expired
cookies.soon.title: Cookies expire soon
cookies.hint: Drop a fresh file in the settings.
settings.hint.ntfy_url: Full topic URL, e.g. https://ntfy.sh/my-nightshift. Leave empty to send nothing.
cookies.signedout.title: Cookies no longer work
settings.hint.cookie_warn_days: Extra warning based on the expiry date. Whether the cookies still work is checked against the site itself, every night.
